title: Native Styles and protected alternative edits for assistants
notes: AI-assisted implementation: discover and apply the live preset catalog with shared GUI Amount baselines and persistent indicators; snapshot unsaved edits in virtual copies, set ratings/labels/flags, assess existing edit depth, open read-only side-by-side Reference View and request user-confirmed deletion. No compare wipe, preset creation/import, personal profile setup or automatic publication. Deleting an original still removes its virtual copies; keep both by default.
